Define the drug-off and drug-on vector fields by $$f_0(z)=\\begin{pmatrix}r_xx(1-x-\\alpha y)\\\\ r_yy(1-y-\\beta x)\\end{pmatrix},\\qquad f_1(z)=\\begin{pmatrix}r_xx(1-x-\\alpha y)-r_dx\\\\ r_yy(1-y-\\beta x)\\end{pmatrix}.$$ Let $\\Gamma\\subseteq\\{z:V(z)=A,\\ 0<x<A\\}$ be a compact arc on which $$g_0(z):=\\nabla V\\cdot f_0(z)\\ge m>0,\\qquad g_1(z):=\\nabla V\\cdot f_1(z)\\le -m<0,$$ with $\\nabla V=(1,1)$. Assume $f_0$ and $f_1$ are $C^2$ near $\\Gamma$, and their flows satisfy $$\\phi_i^t(z)=z+t f_i(z)+O(t^2),\\qquad V(\\phi_i^t(z))=V(z)+t g_i(z)+O(t^2)$$ uniformly for $i\\in\\{0,1\\}$. Let $P_\\delta$ be the intermittent return map obtained by flowing first with $f_1$ from $V=A$ down to $V=A-\\delta$ and then with $f_0$ back to $V=A$, and let $\\Theta_\\delta(z)$ be the corresponding cycle time. Derive the averaged return-map generator $$\\frac{P_\\delta(z)-z}{\\Theta_\\delta(z)}=h(z)+O(\\delta),\\qquad h(z)=\\frac{g_0(z)f_1(z)-g_1(z)f_0(z)}{g_0(z)-g_1(z)}.$$ Then show that $h$ is tangent to the constraint $V=A$, identify the continuous adaptive dose $R_c(z)$ for which $h$ is the constrained continuous adaptive vector field, and explain why the intermittent trajectory satisfies the finite-time error bound $$E_\\delta(T):=\\sup_{0\\le t\\le T}\\max\\{|x_\\delta(t)-x_0(t)|,|y_\\delta(t)-y_0(t)|\\}\\le C_T\\delta$$ on any interval $[0,T]$ where the continuous constrained solution $z_0(t)$ of $\\dot z=h(z)$ remains in $\\Gamma$.",
    "answer": "Start with the drug-on leg of one intermittent cycle. If $\\tau_1$ is the time needed to move from $V=A$ to $V=A-\\delta$, then the expansion for $V(\\phi_1^t(z))$ gives $$A-\\delta=A+\\tau_1 g_1(z)+O(\\tau_1^2).$$ Since $g_1(z)\\le -m<0$, this can be solved for $\\tau_1$ as $$\\tau_1=\\frac{\\delta}{-g_1(z)}+O(\\delta^2).$$ Substituting into the flow expansion for $\\phi_1^t$ yields the intermediate point $$z_1=z+\\tau_1 f_1(z)+O(\\tau_1^2)=z+\\frac{\\delta}{-g_1(z)}f_1(z)+O(\\delta^2).$$ Next, let $\\tau_0$ be the drug-off time needed to return from $V=A-\\delta$ to $V=A$. Using $g_0(z)\\ge m>0$ and the same expansion gives $$\\tau_0=\\frac{\\delta}{g_0(z)}+O(\\delta^2).$$ Therefore the one-cycle displacement and one-cycle time are $$P_\\delta(z)-z=\\tau_1 f_1(z)+\\tau_0 f_0(z)+O(\\delta^2)=\\delta\\left(-\\frac{f_1(z)}{g_1(z)}+\\frac{f_0(z)}{g_0(z)}\\right)+O(\\delta^2),$$ $$\\Theta_\\delta(z)=\\tau_1+\\tau_0=\\delta\\left(-\\frac{1}{g_1(z)}+\\frac{1}{g_0(z)}\\right)+O(\\delta^2).$$ Dividing these expansions gives $$\\frac{P_\\delta(z)-z}{\\Theta_\\delta(z)}=\\frac{f_0(z)/g_0(z)-f_1(z)/g_1(z)}{1/g_0(z)-1/g_1(z)}+O(\\delta)=\\frac{g_0(z)f_1(z)-g_1(z)f_0(z)}{g_0(z)-g_1(z)}+O(\\delta).$$ This is the claimed averaged vector field $h(z)$. To check tangency, compute $$\\nabla V\\cdot h=\\frac{g_0(\\nabla V\\cdot f_1)-g_1(\\nabla V\\cdot f_0)}{g_0-g_1}=\\frac{g_0g_1-g_1g_0}{g_0-g_1}=0.$$ Hence $h$ is tangent to the level set $V=A$, so the averaged dynamics stay on the constraint. To identify the corresponding continuous adaptive dose, use the relation $$f_1=f_0-r_dx(1,0)^T.$$ Taking the dot product with $\\nabla V=(1,1)$ gives $$g_1=g_0-r_dx,\\qquad g_0-g_1=r_dx.$$ The fraction of time spent in the drug-on state in the averaged field is therefore $$\\lambda(z)=\\frac{g_0(z)}{g_0(z)-g_1(z)}=\\frac{g_0(z)}{r_dx},$$ so the averaged drug-removal rate is $$R_c(z)=\\lambda(z)r_d=\\frac{g_0(z)}{x}.$$ Since $$g_0(z)=r_xx(1-x-\\alpha y)+r_yy(1-y-\\beta x),$$ this becomes $$R_c(z)=r_x(1-x-\\alpha y)+\\frac{r_yy(1-y-\\beta x)}{x}.$$ Thus $h$ is exactly the continuous adaptive vector field on $V=A$ with dose $R_c(z)$. Finally, the return map is a consistent one-step discretisation of $\\dot z=h(z)$ with step size $\\Theta_\\delta=O(\\delta)$ and local consistency error $O(\\Theta_\\delta^2)$. Because $h$ is Lipschitz on the compact arc $\\Gamma$, the standard finite-time global error theorem for one-step methods implies that the return points differ from the continuous constrained solution $z_0(t)$ by at most $O(\\delta)$ on $[0,T]$. Between successive return points, the intermittent trajectory stays inside the thin band $A-\\delta\\le V\\le A$ for a time of order $O(\\delta)$, so its within-cycle displacement from the return point is also $O(\\delta)$. Combining the return-point error with the within-cycle error gives constants $C_T<\\infty$ and $\\delta_T>0$ such that $$E_\\delta(T)\\le C_T\\delta$$ for all $0<\\delta\\le \\delta_T$."

import Mathlib

namespace FSLean

noncomputable section

abbrev State := ℝ × ℝ

def V (z : State) : ℝ :=
  z.1 + z.2

def f0 (r_x r_y α β : ℝ) (z : State) : State :=
  (r_x * z.1 * (1 - z.1 - α * z.2), r_y * z.2 * (1 - z.2 - β * z.1))

def f1 (r_x r_y α β r_d : ℝ) (z : State) : State :=
  (r_x * z.1 * (1 - z.1 - α * z.2) - r_d * z.1, r_y * z.2 * (1 - z.2 - β * z.1))

def g0 (r_x r_y α β : ℝ) (z : State) : ℝ :=
  V (f0 r_x r_y α β z)

def g1 (r_x r_y α β r_d : ℝ) (z : State) : ℝ :=
  V (f1 r_x r_y α β r_d z)

def h (r_x r_y α β r_d : ℝ) (z : State) : State :=
  (1 / (g0 r_x r_y α β z - g1 r_x r_y α β r_d z)) •
    ((g0 r_x r_y α β z) • f1 r_x r_y α β r_d z -
      (g1 r_x r_y α β r_d z) • f0 r_x r_y α β z)

def Rc (r_x r_y α β : ℝ) (z : State) : ℝ :=
  g0 r_x r_y α β z / z.1

def adaptiveField (R : State → ℝ) (r_x r_y α β : ℝ) (z : State) : State :=
  ((f0 r_x r_y α β z).1 - R z * z.1, (f0 r_x r_y α β z).2)

def returnMap
    (φ0 φ1 : ℝ → State → State)
    (τ1 τ0 : ℝ → State → ℝ)
    (δ : ℝ) (z : State) : State :=
  φ0 (τ0 δ z) (φ1 (τ1 δ z) z)

def cycleTime (τ1 τ0 : ℝ → State → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (z : State) : ℝ :=
  τ1 δ z + τ0 δ z

def maxNorm (z : State) : ℝ :=
  max |z.1| |z.2|

def HasQuadraticVectorExpansion
    (Γ : Set State) (φ : ℝ → State → State) (F : State → State) : Prop :=
  ∃ C t0, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 < t0 ∧
    ∀ z ∈ Γ, ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ t0 →
      maxNorm (φ t z - (z + t • F z)) ≤ C * t ^ 2

def HasQuadraticBurdenExpansion
    (Γ : Set State) (φ : ℝ → State → State) (g : State → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C t0, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 < t0 ∧
    ∀ z ∈ Γ, ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ t0 →
      |V (φ t z) - (V z + t * g z)| ≤ C * t ^ 2

def trajectoryError (zδ z0 : ℝ → State) (T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup ((fun t => max |(zδ t).1 - (z0 t).1| |(zδ t).2 - (z0 t).2|) '' Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T)

def HitsConstraintBand
    (Γ : Set State) (A : ℝ)
    (φ0 φ1 : ℝ → State → State)
    (τ1 τ0 : ℝ → State → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ z ∈ Γ, ∀ δ, 0 < δ →
    V (φ1 (τ1 δ z) z) = A - δ ∧
    V (returnMap φ0 φ1 τ1 τ0 δ z) = A

def IsIntermittentTrajectory
    (φ0 φ1 : ℝ → State → State)
    (τ1 τ0 : ℝ → State → ℝ)
    (δ : ℝ)
    (z : ℝ → State)
    (ξ : ℕ → State)
    (σ : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  σ 0 = 0 ∧
  ξ 0 = z 0 ∧
  (∀ n, ξ (n + 1) = returnMap φ0 φ1 τ1 τ0 δ (ξ n)) ∧
  (∀ n, σ (n + 1) = σ n + cycleTime τ1 τ0 δ (ξ n)) ∧
  (∀ n t, σ n ≤ t → t ≤ σ n + τ1 δ (ξ n) →
    z t = φ1 (t - σ n) (ξ n)) ∧
  (∀ n s, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ τ0 δ (ξ n) →
    z (σ n + τ1 δ (ξ n) + s) = φ0 s (φ1 (τ1 δ (ξ n)) (ξ n)))

lemma g1_eq_g0_sub (r_x r_y α β r_d : ℝ) (z : State) :
    g1 r_x r_y α β r_d z = g0 r_x r_y α β z - r_d * z.1 := by
  unfold g1 g0 V f0 f1
  ring

lemma denom_eq (r_x r_y α β r_d : ℝ) (z : State) :
    g0 r_x r_y α β z - g1 r_x r_y α β r_d z = r_d * z.1 := by
  rw [g1_eq_g0_sub]
  ring

lemma Rc_formula (r_x r_y α β : ℝ) (z : State) (hz1 : z.1 ≠ 0) :
    Rc r_x r_y α β z =
      r_x * (1 - z.1 - α * z.2) +
        (r_y * z.2 * (1 - z.2 - β * z.1)) / z.1 := by
  unfold Rc g0 V f0
  rw [add_div]
  congr 1
  calc
    r_x * z.1 * (1 - z.1 - α * z.2) / z.1
        = (r_x * (1 - z.1 - α * z.2) * z.1) / z.1 := by ring
    _ = r_x * (1 - z.1 - α * z.2) := by
      exact mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hz1

lemma adaptiveField_tangent (r_x r_y α β : ℝ) (z : State) (hz1 : z.1 ≠ 0) :
    V (adaptiveField (Rc r_x r_y α β) r_x r_y α β z) = 0 := by
  have hRc : Rc r_x r_y α β z * z.1 = g0 r_x r_y α β z := by
    unfold Rc
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hz1
  calc
    V (adaptiveField (Rc r_x r_y α β) r_x r_y α β z)
        = g0 r_x r_y α β z - Rc r_x r_y α β z * z.1 := by
          unfold adaptiveField g0 V f0
          ring
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [hRc]
      ring

lemma h_eq_adaptiveField
    (r_x r_y α β r_d : ℝ) (z : State)
    (hz1 : z.1 ≠ 0) (hdenom : g0 r_x r_y α β z - g1 r_x r_y α β r_d z ≠ 0) :
    h r_x r_y α β r_d z = adaptiveField (Rc r_x r_y α β) r_x r_y α β z := by
  have hrdx : r_d * z.1 ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [denom_eq r_x r_y α β r_d z] using hdenom
  have hrd : r_d ≠ 0 := by
    intro hrd0
    apply hrdx
    simp [hrd0]
  ext <;>
  simp [h, adaptiveField, Rc, g0, g1, V, f0, f1, Prod.smul_mk, denom_eq]
  · field_simp [hz1, hrd]
    ring
  · field_simp [hz1, hrd]
    ring

lemma h_tangent
    (r_x r_y α β r_d : ℝ) (z : State)
    (hz1 : z.1 ≠ 0) (hdenom : g0 r_x r_y α β z - g1 r_x r_y α β r_d z ≠ 0) :
    V (h r_x r_y α β r_d z) = 0 := by
  rw [h_eq_adaptiveField r_x r_y α β r_d z hz1 hdenom]
  exact adaptiveField_tangent r_x r_y α β z hz1
